title: Parallel Broyden Methods for Efficiently Evaluating Nonlinear State Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.13523v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nonlinear state space models are typically evaluated sequentially, limiting their ability to exploit modern parallel hardware. Recent work has shown that state space models can be evaluated in parallel by reformulating evaluation as a root-finding problem, which can be solved with a parallel form of Newton's method. However, exact Newton methods require expensive multiplication of dense Jacobian matrices, and quasi-Newton methods based on diagonal approximations, while more scalable, are often slow to converge because they neglect interactions across state dimensions. We introduce a novel quasi-Newton approach based on Broyden's method, which captures coupling terms with diagonal-plus-low-rank approximations to blocks of the Jacobian. translated_title: 高效评估非线性状态空间模型的并行Broyden方法
translated_abstract: 非线性状态空间模型通常需要按顺序进行评估，这限制了它们利用现代并行硬件的能力。近期研究表明，可以通过将评估重新表述为求根问题来实现状态空间模型的并行评估，该问题可用并行形式的牛顿法求解。然而，精确的牛顿法需要对密集雅可比矩阵进行昂贵的乘法运算，而基于对角近似的拟牛顿法虽然更具可扩展性，但由于忽略了状态维度之间的相互作用，往往收敛缓慢。我们提出了一种基于Broyden方法的新型拟牛顿方法，该方法通过对雅可比矩阵的块进行对角加低秩近似来捕获耦合项。我们从轨迹割线构建这些近似，在避免使用自动微分的同时，保留了对角近似良好的可扩展性，并保持了与并行扫描的兼容性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Broyden方法的新型并行拟牛顿方法，通过对雅可比矩阵块进行对角加低秩近似来捕获状态维度间的耦合项，从而在不牺牲收敛速度和并行扫描兼容性的前提下，高效评估非线性状态空间模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel parallel quasi-Newton approach based on Broyden's method, which captures coupling terms via diagonal-plus-low-rank approximations to Jacobian blocks, enabling efficient parallel evaluation of nonlinear state space models while retaining favorable scaling and compatibility with parallel scans.
